# Core CI

[Back to Workflow Reference](WORKFLOWS.md#core-ci)

| Workflow                                             | Type       | Runner                   | Docker | Purpose                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | ------------------------ | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [CI](ci.yml)                                         | Standalone | [job inventory](JOBS.md) | Mixed  | PR and merge-group semantic-DAG orchestrator on every PR base, including stacked PRs. It dispatches change detection, per-area static gates, topology-aware test selection, report processing, and required test/build gates; executable control logic lives in callable workflows or local actions. |
| [CI Detect Changes](ci-detect-changes.yml)           | Reusable   | `ubuntu-slim`            | No     | Applies external path filters and trusted-context classification.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| [CI Test Coverage](ci-test-coverage.yml)             | Reusable   | `ubuntu-latest`          | No     | Merges sparse patch-coverage evidence and enforces the PR patch gate without OIDC.                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| [CI Codecov Upload](ci-upload-codecov.yml)           | Reusable   | `ubuntu-latest`          | No     | Separately uploads full LCOV to Codecov using OIDC and only pinned external actions; its result does not gate required checks.                                                                                                                                                                       |
| [CI Tests Processing](ci-tests-processing.yml)       | Reusable   | `ubuntu-latest`          | No     | Merges Vitest reports from GitHub fallback artifacts, enforces test fan-in, and cleans transport artifacts.                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| [Main Backend](main-backend.yml)                     | Standalone | inherited via uses       | Mixed  | Main-branch backend static gate and parallel backend test families; successful completion is dispatched centrally to private infrastructure.                                                                                                                                                         |
| [Main Web](main-web.yml)                             | Standalone | inherited via uses       | Mixed  | Main-branch web static gate, Vitest, integration, sibling Playwright suites, and optional OTel storage; a successful web-deploy-intent marker is dispatched centrally while Lambda/worker-only validation runs do not deploy web.                                                                    |
| [Main Storybook](main-storybook.yml)                 | Standalone | inherited via uses       | No     | Main-branch Storybook validation and static artifact build.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| [Main Cloudflare Worker](main-cloudflare-worker.yml) | Standalone | inherited via uses       | Mixed  | Main-branch Worker static checks and tests, followed by credential-free publication of the attempt-bound Wrangler bundle; successful completion is dispatched centrally to private infrastructure, which owns deployment mutation.                                                                   |
| [Main Lambdas](main-lambdas.yml)                     | Standalone | inherited via uses       | Mixed  | Main-branch Lambda tests; successful completion is dispatched centrally to private infrastructure.                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| [Main Checks](main-checks.yml)                       | Standalone | inherited via uses       | No     | Main-branch tooling, shared TypeScript, and EXPLAIN ANALYZE tests; `select-main-checks` starts only the matching suite.                                                                                                                                                                              |
| [Initialize Smoke Test](initialize-smoke-test.yml)   | Reusable   | `ubuntu-latest`          | Yes    | Verifies `./dev/initialize` setup paths.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| [Static Code Analysis](static-code-analysis.yml)     | Both       | `ubuntu-latest`          | No     | Runs cross-repo lint, formatting, dependency, shell, and repository policy checks on PRs and main.                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| [Static Checks](checks-static.yml)                   | Reusable   | `ubuntu-latest`          | No     | Backend, web, Lambda, and Cloudflare Worker typecheck/build/smoke gates. PR CI calls each area separately so one area's static failure blocks only its related tests; grouped main workflows call the same reusable workflow once for their area.                                                    |
| [EXPLAIN ANALYZE](explain-analyze.yml)               | Reusable   | `ubuntu-latest`          | Yes    | Runs seeded identity, plan-shape, and resource-pressure regression gates.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
